description: This file contains a set of test cases for the 'git send-pack' command, specifically testing its behavior with various refspecs, stdin input, and options like --mirror. It defines helper functions for creating references and verifying pushes, and performs multiple test scenarios to validate correct functionality and error handling.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates a git reference with the specified name pointing to a new commit built from the provided message.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Initializes a new bare remote git repository, removing any existing one.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that a specific reference has been successfully pushed to the remote repository.
